New York’s Betnijah Laney-Hamilton was ejected Sunday, after committing one of the [strangest fouls](https://www.instagram.com/p/DatVHWHRpfO/) in WNBA history…


--------------------
## USWNT to play Spain in October

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/03de9e44-2215-47d1-9709-a84bfe625450/GettyImages-1436603767__1_.jpg?t=1783949047) [Sophia Smith #11 of the United States is marked by Esther Gonzale #9 of Spain during a game between Spain and USWNT at El Sadar Stadium on October 11, 2022 in Pamplona, Spain. ]
Caption: One of the October’s two USWNT games will be played in Washington, DC. (Erin Chang/ISI Photos/Getty Images)

**The USWNT is ready for October, **announcing plans to play two friendlies against reigning champion Spain in the last FIFA window before [World Cup qualifiers](https://justwomenssports.com/reads/fifa-womens-world-cup-2027-format-qualifiers-guide/).

* The US first faces the European titan at Washington, DC’s Audi Field on October 10th, before capping the series at Pennsylvania’s Subaru Park on October 13th.
